desc:
🔥 Welcome to Forge, where every hammer strike puts your fortune on the line!

⚒️ Heat your swords, strike the anvil, and push for higher grades—but risk damaging or breaking your blade with every hit!
🐉 Offer your creations to the dragon and meet its growing daily tribute demands to survive!
🔮 Collect relics, combine their effects, and trade with the mysterious ghost merchant to improve your chances!
📱 Supports PC, mobile, and tablet.

🚧 Still in development—bug reports and feedback are welcome!
💬 We welcome your bug reports, feedback, and suggestions—thanks for helping shape Forge!
👍1,000 LIKEs → new update + rewards!!!
